name: Mumbai
description: The gully rap epicentre. Street storytelling in Hindi and Bambaiya slang out of Kurla, Andheri and Dharavi, pushed into the mainstream by Gully Boy.

name: Pune
description: A second Maharashtra hub that proved raw, self-made rap could top charts without a big label behind it.

name: Delhi
description: Technical, lyric-heavy and fiercely independent. Home to boom bap purists, trap innovators and some of the scene's best known labels.

name: Punjab
description: Where desi rap first met bhangra and pop. Punjabi flows, dhol-driven beats and a crossover pipeline into film and global charts.

name: Haryana
description: Haryanvi dialect rap with a rural edge and an internet-first audience. Still early in this dataset and actively being seeded.

name: Kerala
description: Malayalam rap that grew from protest verses and cinema crossovers into one of the most exciting regional scenes in the country.

name: Chennai
description: Tamil hip hop rooted in folk forms, oppari and gaana, with a strong voice for land, labour and caste.

name: Bengaluru
description: A multilingual city scene moving between English, Kannada, Hindi and Malayalam, and the launchpad for DHH's biggest global viral moment.

name: Gujarat
description: Amdavad's underground: Gujarati and Hindi bars over boom bap, trap and funk, built by a tight crew who keep putting each other on every record.

name: Nagpur
description: Central India's rising hub. Hindi and Marathi bars out of Nagpur's moshpits, from a young crew who produce, shoot and perform for each other.

name: Dehradun
description: Rap from the hills of Uttarakhand's capital: rapid-fire Hindi and English flows with a design-first eye for visuals.

name: Goa
description: A small but distinct scene where rap meets R&B, afrobeats and Goa's own long musical history, a history that has nothing to do with anybody's vacation playlist.

name: Uttar Pradesh
description: Small-town rap from the heartland, where artists turn village roots and the long road to the city into their whole story.

name: Indore
description: Madhya Pradesh's rap capital, which crowned its first MTV Hustle champion in 2024.

name: Kolkata
description: A city of poets and protest songs, where rap picks up the tradition of speaking truth to power.

name: Kashmir
description: Introspective, political rap from the valley, documenting life under conflict.

name: Pakistan
description: Across the border, Karachi and Lahore run a scene of their own in Urdu, Punjabi and English. It shares fans, producers and the occasional beef with India's.

name: Diaspora
description: Artists based in the UK and North America whose Punjabi and Hindi rap shaped the sound back home.
